title: Hanyoyin sufuri
description: Ten short stories about getting around in Hausaland: a dusty dry-season bus ride from Kano to Kaduna, a couple held up by a flood on the way to a naming ceremony, an engineer's flight to Abuja with a model bus stop, a trader waiting all night at a locked border post, a fire at a Kano bus station, a long journey home for the Sallah festivals, an argument about betting on the Kaduna train, the radio news in an Abuja taxi, a widow's tricycle service for women and a pig on a farm road near Jos.

lessons.title: Bas zuwa Kaduna
lessons.summary: The student Nafi'atu takes a dusty dry-season bus from Kano to Kaduna; a passenger lights a cigarette though the driver has forbidden smoking, an old woman shouts at him, and on the way she tells Nafi'atu about Queen Amina of Zaria.
lessons.text:
Nafi'atu ɗaliba ce a jami'a a Kaduna, amma iyayenta suna zaune a Kano. Bayan hutun mako biyu, ta tashi da wuri domin ta hau bas zuwa Kaduna. Lokacin rani ne. Babu ruwan sama tun watanni, kuma iska tana ɗauke da ƙura.

A tashar mota, ta sayi tikiti, sannan ta sayi kwalbar ruwa biyu. Mahaifiyarta ta ce mata, "A lokacin rani, kada ki yi tafiya ba tare da ruwa ba."

Nafi'atu ta zauna a gefen hagu, kusa da taga. Kusa da ita akwai wata tsohuwar mace. Direban bas ɗin wani dattijo ne mai suna Malam Mati. Kafin ya tashi, ya tsaya a gaban mutane ya ce, "Barka da safiya. Ku sani cewa an haramta shan sigari a cikin wannan bas. Idan kuna son shan sigari, sai mun tsaya."

Bayan awa ɗaya, wani mutum da ke zaune a bayan Nafi'atu ya kunna sigari. Sai tsohuwar ta yi ihu, "Kai! Ba ka ji abin da direba ya ce ba? An haramta sigari a nan!" Wasu mutane su ma suka yi ihu.

Malam Mati ya tsayar da bas ɗin a gefen hanya. Ya ce wa mutumin, "Ko ka kashe sigarin nan, ko ka sauka." Mutumin ya ji kunya. Ya kashe sigarin, ya ce, "Ku yi haƙuri."

Ƙura tana shigowa ta taga, sai Nafi'atu ta rufe tagar gefen hagu. Ta sha ruwa daga kwalbarta, sannan ta ba tsohuwar ɗayan kwalbar, domin tsohuwar ba ta da ruwa.

Da suka wuce Zaria, tsohuwar ta nuna mata tsohon garin. Ta ce, "A zamanin da, Sarauniya Amina ce sarauniyar Zazzau. Ta yi yaƙi da yawa, kuma ta sa garinta ya yi ƙarfi." Nafi'atu ta ce, "Na karanta labarin sarauniyar a makaranta, amma ban taɓa ganin garinta ba sai yau."

Bayan haka, gajiya ta kama Nafi'atu, sai ta yi barci. Da ta tashi, sun kusa isa Kaduna. Malam Mati ya ce, "Na san duk kun gaji, amma gajiyar tafiya ba ta daɗewa."

Da suka isa tasha, Nafi'atu ta sauka da jakarta. Duk tufafinta sun yi ja saboda ƙura. Ta yi wa Malam Mati godiya. Ta ce wa kanta, "A lokacin rani, tafiya da bas tana da wuya, amma direba nagari yana sa ta yi sauƙi."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa iska take ɗauke da ƙura?
Saboda lokacin rani ne, kuma babu ruwan sama tun watanni.
A wane gefe Nafi'atu ta zauna?
Ta zauna a gefen hagu, kusa da taga.
Me direba ya ce game da sigari?
Ya ce an haramta shan sigari a cikin bas ɗin.
Me tsohuwar ta yi da mutumin ya kunna sigari?
Ta yi ihu, ta ce masa an haramta sigari a nan.
Wace ce Sarauniya Amina?
Ita ce sarauniyar Zazzau a zamanin da.
Me Nafi'atu ta ba tsohuwar?
Ta ba ta ɗayan kwalbar ruwanta.

lessons.title: Ambaliya a hanyar Azare
lessons.summary: The married couple Muhammadu and Zuhura drive from Kano to a naming ceremony for her sister Hamdiyya's first child in Azare; a flood covers the bridge, they wait in the car all night until the water goes down, and arrive just in time.
lessons.text:
Muhammadu da Zuhura ma'aurata ne, kuma suna zaune a Kano. Wata rana a lokacin damina, Zuhura ta sami saƙo daga 'yar uwarta Hamdiyya, wadda take zaune a Azare. A cikin saƙon, Hamdiyya ta faɗa mata cewa ta haifi ɗa namiji. Ta kuma aiko musu da gayyata zuwa bikin sunan jaririn a ƙarshen mako.

Zuhura ta ce wa mijinta, "Wannan ita ce haifuwa ta farko a gidansu. Dole mu je." Muhammadu ya ce, "To, mun karɓi gayyatar. Za mu tafi da motarmu kwana ɗaya kafin bikin."

Kwana ɗaya kafin bikin suka tashi daga Kano. Makomarsu ita ce Azare, wadda take da nisan kilomita 200. Ruwan sama ya fara sauka da ƙarfi. Da suka kai wani ƙauye, sai suka ga motoci da yawa a tsaye a gefen hanya. Wani jami'in 'yansanda ya ce musu, "Ba za ku iya tafiya gaba ba. Akwai ambaliya a gaba. Ruwan kogi ya rufe gadar."

Muhammadu ya tambaye shi, "Akwai wata hanya dabam?" Jami'in ya ce, "Akwai hanya dabam ta wani gari, amma tana da nisa, kuma ita ma ruwa ya cika ta."

Ma'auratan suka yi shawara. Zuhura ta ce, "Bari mu jira a nan. Idan ruwan ya fara raguwa, sai mu wuce." Suka zauna a cikin mota suna jira. Sabili da ambaliyar, mutane da yawa sun kwana a hanya a wannan dare.

Da safe, ruwan sama ya tsaya, kuma ruwan kogin ya fara raguwa a hankali. Bayan awa uku, jami'in ya ce, "An sami raguwar ruwa sosai. Za ku iya tafiya, amma ku yi tafiya a hankali."

Tafiyar ta yi wuya, amma ma'auratan sun nuna juriya. Muhammadu ya tuƙa mota a hankali har suka wuce gadar. Zuhura ta ce, "Na gode da juriyarka. Da juriya ne mutum yake kai makomarsa."

Sun isa Azare da rana, a daidai lokacin bikin suna. Da Hamdiyya ta ga 'yar uwarta, sai ta yi kuka. Hawaye suka fito daga idanunta, amma hawayen farin ciki ne. Ta ce, "Na ji labarin ambaliyar a rediyo, na ɗauka ba za ku zo ba." Zuhura ma ta yi hawaye, ta ɗauki jaririn a hannunta.

Sabili da gajiyar tafiya da murnar haifuwar, ma'auratan sun yi kwana biyu a Azare kafin su koma Kano.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Muhammadu da Zuhura za su je Azare?
Sun karɓi gayyata zuwa bikin sunan jaririn Hamdiyya.
Me ya hana su tafiya gaba?
Akwai ambaliya a gaba, kuma ruwan kogi ya rufe gadar.
Me ya sa ba su bi wata hanya dabam ba?
Saboda hanya dabam tana da nisa, kuma ita ma ruwa ya cika ta.
Yaushe suka wuce gadar?
Sun wuce gadar da safe, bayan ruwan ya yi raguwa.
Me ya sa Hamdiyya ta yi hawaye?
Ta yi hawayen farin ciki da ta ga 'yar uwarta.

lessons.title: Gabatarwa a Abuja
lessons.summary: The engineer Raihana, with years of experience, flies from Kano to Abuja with a model bus stop, rehearses in her hotel room, and her presentation wins her company the contract from the transport manager Alhaji Abdussamad.
lessons.text:
Raihana injiniya ce a wani kamfani a Kano. Tana da shekara 34, kuma tana da gogewar aiki ta shekara goma. Wata rana manajan kamfaninsu ya kira ta ofishinsa. Ya ce, "Raihana, wani kamfanin motoci a Abuja yana son a gina masa sababbin tashoshin bas guda goma. Ina so ki je ki yi gabatarwa a gabansu. Ke ce kika fi kowa gogewa a wannan aiki."

Raihana ta yi aiki dare da rana har mako biyu. Ta shirya cikakkiyar gabatarwa, ta kuma yi ƙaramin samfurin tashar bas da katako. Samfurin yana da kujeru, da wurin ajiye kaya, da fitilu. Duk wanda ya gan shi zai fahimci yadda tashar za ta kasance.

Ranar Lahadi ta hau jirgin sama zuwa Abuja. Ta riƙe samfurin a hannunta har jirgin ya sauka, domin ba ta so ya karye. A Abuja, ta sauka a wani otal kusa da ofishin kamfanin. Otal ɗin yana da tsabta, kuma ɗakinta yana da babban tebur. Ta ajiye samfurin a kan teburin, ta sake karanta gabatarwarta sau uku.

Washegari, ta tashi da wuri. Ta yi wanka, ta yi kwalliya kaɗan, ta gyara sumarta, sannan ta ɗaura ɗankwali a kan sumar. Ba ta son kwalliya mai yawa. Tana son a ga aikinta, ba kwalliyarta ba.

Da ta isa ofishin kamfanin, wata ma'aikaciya ta kai ta wani babban ɗaki. A tsakiyar ɗakin akwai wani dogon tebur. Manajan kamfanin, Alhaji Abdussamad, yana zaune a gaban teburin tare da mutane huɗu. Raihana ta ajiye samfurin a kan teburin, ta fara gabatarwarta.

Ta yi bayani yadda tashar za ta kare mutane daga rana da ruwan sama, da yadda za a gina ta da kuɗi kaɗan. Bayan ta gama, manajan ya tambaye ta, "Kina da gogewa a irin wannan aiki?" Ta ce, "Eh, na gina tashoshi biyar a Kano. Gogewar da na samu a can ce ta koya mini abin da mutane suke buƙata."

Alhaji Abdussamad ya yi murmushi. Ya ce, "Na ga azama a idanunki. Wannan cikakkiyar gabatarwa ce, kuma samfurinki ya fi duk wanda muka gani." Bayan kwana biyu, kamfanin ya ce zai ba kamfanin Raihana aikin.

Da yamma, Raihana ta koma otal, ta kira manajanta a Kano. Ta ce, "Mun sami aikin!" Manajanta ya ce, "Na san za ki iya. Azamarki ce ta kai ki."

Tambayoyi:
Gogewar aiki ta shekara nawa Raihana take da ita?
Tana da gogewar aiki ta shekara goma.
Me Raihana ta yi da katako?
Ta yi ƙaramin samfurin tashar bas da katako.
Ina ta ajiye samfurin a otal?
Ta ajiye shi a kan babban teburin ɗakinta.
Me ya sa ba ta son kwalliya mai yawa?
Saboda tana son a ga aikinta, ba kwalliyarta ba.
Me Alhaji Abdussamad ya gani a idanunta?
Ya ga azama a idanunta.

lessons.title: Iyakar da aka kulle
lessons.summary: Hamani, a cloth trader from Maradi, reaches the Jibiya border post at midnight to find it locked; he refuses two young men's offer of a bush path, sleeps by the mosque, hears the roosters at dawn and crosses under the two flags.
lessons.text:
Hamani ɗan kasuwa ne da ke zaune a Maradi, a Jamhuriyar Nijar. Yana sayar da tufafi a kasuwar Maradi. Kowane wata yakan ƙetare iyaka zuwa Najeriya, ya je Kano ya sayi kaya.

Wata rana ya tashi daga Maradi da yamma a cikin wata ƙaramar mota. Hanyar ta lalace, saboda haka suka isa iyaka a tsakar dare. Iyakar tana tsakanin ƙasashe biyu: Jamhuriyar Nijar da Tarayyar Najeriya.

Da suka isa, sai suka ga an kulle ƙofar iyakar. Wani soja ya ce musu, "Ana kulle iyaka da ƙarfe 10 na dare. Sai da safe za a buɗe ta." Direban ya ce, "Mun zo a tsakar dare, ba mu da yadda za mu yi. Sai mu jira."

Sai wasu samari biyu suka zo wurin Hamani. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ce, "Malam, kada ka jira har safe. Ka ba mu kuɗi kaɗan, mu ƙetare da kai ta wata hanya a cikin daji. Babu soja a can."

Hamani ya ƙi. Ya ce, "A'a, na gode." Ya san cewa ƙetare iyaka ta daji laifi ne, kuma hanya ce mai haɗari. Ya guji samarin, ya koma ya zauna kusa da motar. Ya ce wa direban, "Mahaifina ya koya mini biyayya ga doka. Ba zan bi hanyar ɓarayi ba." Direban ya ce, "Ka yi daidai. Ni ma kullum nakan guji irin waɗannan samarin."

Hamani ya kwana a ƙasa kusa da masallacin da ke iyakar. Da wayewar gari, ya ji wani zakara yana kuka. Wani zakara kuma ya amsa daga wani gida. Hamani ya tashi, ya yi sallah.

Bayan wayewar gari, aka buɗe ƙofar iyaka. Hamani ya ga tutoci biyu a sama: tutar Nijar mai launin ruwan lemu, fari da kore, da tutar Najeriya mai launin kore da fari. Sojoji suna tsaye a ƙarƙashin tutocin, suna duba takardun mutane.

Wani soja ya duba takardun Hamani. Ya ce, "Na ga ka kwana a nan, ba ka bi waɗannan samarin ba. Na gode da biyayyarka." Hamani ya yi farin ciki, ya ƙetare iyakar a cikin motar. A daidai lokacin, zakaran nan ya sake yin kuka.

Da yamma ya isa Kano lafiya, ya sayi kayansa.

Tambayoyi:
A wace ƙasa Hamani yake zaune?
Yana zaune a Maradi, a Jamhuriyar Nijar.
Yaushe suka isa iyaka?
Sun isa iyaka a tsakar dare.
Me ya sa ba su ƙetare iyakar da dare ba?
Saboda an kulle ƙofar iyakar da ƙarfe 10 na dare.
Me ya sa Hamani ya guji samarin?
Saboda ƙetare iyaka ta daji laifi ne, kuma mahaifinsa ya koya masa biyayya ga doka.
Me Hamani ya ji da wayewar gari?
Ya ji zakara yana kuka.
Wane launi ne tutar Nijar take da shi?
Tutar Nijar tana da launin ruwan lemu, fari da kore.

lessons.title: Gobara a tashar Naibawa
lessons.summary: Sulaiman, a bus driver at Naibawa station in Kano, refuses to carry a woman's gas cylinder on his roof; she puts it on another bus, a man burning rubbish sets the luggage on fire, and Sulaiman keeps the flames away from the cylinder.
lessons.text:
Sulaiman direban bas ne a tashar Naibawa da ke Kano. Yana tuƙa bas tsakanin Kano da Zaria. Motarsa tana amfani da gas maimakon man fetur, saboda gas ya fi sauƙin kuɗi.

Wata safiya, mutane suna ajiye kayansu a kan rufin bas ɗin. Yaron mota yana taimaka musu, yana ɗora kaya a kan rufin. Sai wata mata ta zo da kwalbar gas ta girki. Ta ce, "Don Allah a ɗora mini wannan a kan rufi."

Sulaiman ya ce, "A'a, baiwar Allah. Ba ma ɗaukar kwalbar gas a kan rufi. Idan rana ta yi zafi, ko wuta ta taɓa ta, za ta iya janyo babbar matsala." Matar ta yi fushi, ta ɗauki kwalbarta ta tafi wani bas.

Bayan minti ashirin, a bayan tashar, wani mutum yana ƙona shara. Iska ta ɗauki wuta daga sharar, ta kai ta kan rufin wani bas da ke kusa. A kan rufin bas ɗin akwai kaya da yawa, har da kwalbar gas ta matar nan.

Kayan suka kama wuta. Mutane suka fara ihu, wasu suka gudu a guje. Sulaiman ma ya tashi a guje, ya ɗauki na'urar kashe wuta daga motarsa. Ya ce wa mutane, "Ku yi nesa! Akwai gas a kan rufin nan!"

Sulaiman ya hau rufin, ya kashe wutar da ke kusa da kwalbar gas. Bayan minti goma, ma'aikatan kashe gobara suka iso, suka kashe sauran wutar. Kafin su iso, kaya da yawa sun ƙone. Kwalbar gas ɗin ba ta fashe ba, saboda Sulaiman ya kashe wutar da ke kusa da ita. Babu wanda ya ji rauni.

Daga baya, wani jami'in kashe gobara ya bayyana sanadiyyar gobarar. Ya ce, "Mutumin da ya ƙona shara a kusa da motoci ne ya haddasa gobarar. Kuma kwalbar gas a kan rufi za ta iya janyo mutuwar mutane da yawa." Ya jaddada cewa an hana ƙona shara a cikin tasha, kuma an hana ɗaukar gas a kan rufin mota.

Matar ta zo wurin Sulaiman, ta ce, "Ka yi gaskiya. Kayana duka sun ƙone, amma na gode Allah ba a rasa rai ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Sulaiman bai ɗauki kwalbar gas ɗin ba?
Saboda kwalbar gas a kan rufi za ta iya janyo babbar matsala.
Me jami'in ya ce game da sanadiyyar gobarar?
Wani mutum yana ƙona shara a bayan tashar, sai iska ta kai wuta kan rufin wani bas.
Wa ya haddasa gobarar?
Mutumin da ya ƙona shara a kusa da motoci ne ya haddasa ta.
Me Sulaiman ya yi?
Ya hau rufin bas ɗin a guje, ya kashe wutar da ke kusa da kwalbar gas.
Me jami'in ya jaddada?
Ya jaddada cewa an hana ƙona shara a tasha da ɗaukar gas a kan rufin mota.

lessons.title: Sallah a Katsina
lessons.summary: Abdulhamid, who works in a Lagos bank, travels home to Katsina for the Sallah festivals; he visits relatives with his cousins, watches horsemen with swords and the emir's followers at the Durbar, hears the praise singers and the drums, and prays at his late grandfather's grave.
lessons.text:
Abdulhamid yana aiki a wani banki a Legas. Ya yi shekara uku bai je gida Katsina ba. A wannan shekara, ya ɗauki hutu domin ya je bukukuwan Sallah tare da 'yan uwansa, kuma domin ziyartar kakarsa.

Tafiyar daga Legas zuwa Katsina tana da nisa sosai. Abdulhamid ya hau bas da dare, kuma sun yi tafiya kusan awa goma sha biyar. Ya gaji, amma yana farin ciki.

Da ya isa gidansu, kakarsa ta fito tana murna. Gidan na marigayi kakansa ne, Alhaji Shitu, wanda ya rasu shekara biyar da suka wuce. Kakarsa ta ce, "Marigayi kakanka yana son duk jikokinsa su riƙa zuwa gida a lokacin Sallah. Zumunta ita ce arzikinmu."

Da safe suka je filin sallah, suka yi sallah. Bayan sallah, Abdulhamid da 'yan uwansa suka tafi ziyarta: gidan ɗan uwan mahaifinsa, gidan ƙanwar mahaifiyarsa, gidan wani tsohon abokin kakansa. Duk inda suka je, ana ba su abinci, ana yi musu addu'a. Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Wannan zumunci da muke yi a lokacin bukukuwa yana ƙarfafa zumunta a cikin iyali."

Da rana suka je kallon hawan Sallah a ƙofar fadar sarki. Dawakai da yawa sun zo, an yi musu ado da kaya masu launi. Mutanen da ke kan dawakan suna riƙe da takubba masu haske. Wani dattijo a kan doki ya riƙe takobinsa sama yayin da yake tafiya, mutane suka yi ihu da murna.

Mabiyan sarki suna tafiya a bayan dokinsa. Wasu mabiya suna tafiya a ƙafa, wasu a kan dawakai. Mawaƙa suna rera waƙoƙin yabon sarki, kuma ana jin kiɗan ganga daga ko'ina. Abdulhamid ya ce wa wani ɗan uwansa, "A Legas ba ma jin irin wannan kiɗan." Ɗan uwan nasa ya ce, "Shi ya sa dole ka riƙa zuwa gida. Zumuncin iyali da al'adarmu suna nan." Mawaƙan suka ci gaba da rera waƙa har yamma.

Kafin ya koma Legas, Abdulhamid ya je kabarin marigayi kakansa, ya yi masa addu'a. Sannan ya ce wa kakarsa, "Ko a ina nake, zan riƙa zuwa bukukuwan Sallah a gida, kuma zan riƙa ziyartar ki."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Abdulhamid ya ɗauki hutu?
Domin ya je bukukuwan Sallah, kuma domin ziyartar kakarsa.
Wane ne Alhaji Shitu?
Shi ne marigayi kakan Abdulhamid.
Me mahaifinsa ya ce game da zumunci?
Ya ce zumuncin da suke yi a lokacin bukukuwa yana ƙarfafa zumunta a cikin iyali.
Me dattijon ya yi da takobinsa?
Ya riƙe takobinsa sama yayin da yake tafiya.
Me mawaƙa suke yi?
Suna rera waƙoƙin yabon sarki.

lessons.title: Jirgin ƙasa zuwa Abuja
lessons.summary: On the train from Kaduna to Abuja the retired teacher Malam Tanimu shares his suya with two young football fans, Aminullahi and Yazid, whose rivalry turns into a bet; he tells them gambling is forbidden, and they set the money aside instead.
lessons.text:
Malam Tanimu tsohon malamin makaranta ne da ke zaune a Kaduna. 'Yarsa tana aure a Abuja, kuma yakan je ya gan ta ta jirgin ƙasa.

Kafin ya hau jirgin, ya sayi tsire a bakin tashar. Mai tsiren ya sa masa tsiren a cikin takarda, ya zuba masa yaji. Malam Tanimu ya ce, "Tsiren Kaduna ya fi na ko'ina daɗi."

A cikin jirgin, ya zauna kusa da wasu samari biyu, Aminullahi da Yazid. Suna magana game da wasan ƙwallon ƙafa da za a yi a ranar. Aminullahi yana goyon bayan ƙungiyar Kano, Yazid kuma yana goyon bayan ƙungiyar Kaduna. Akwai tsohuwar hamayya tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu, kuma kowa yana cewa ƙungiyarsa ta fi.

Hamayyarsu ta yi zafi, sai Aminullahi ya ce, "Bari mu yi caca. Na sa naira dubu goma cewa Kano za ta ci." Yazid ya ce, "To, na yarda." Suka fito da kuɗinsu.

Malam Tanimu ya ce, "Ku yi haƙuri, 'ya'yana. Hamayya a wasa ba laifi ba ce, amma caca haram ce. Zunubi ne a ci kuɗin wani ta hanyar caca."

Aminullahi ya ce, "Baba, wannan shirme ne. Ba caca ba ce, wasa ne kawai." Malam Tanimu ya ce, "Ba shirme ba ne. Kuna cewa wasa ne, alhali kuwa kuɗinku na gaske ne. Idan ka rasa dubu goma, me za ka ci gobe? Kuma ko da ka ci, kuɗin haram ba shi da albarka."

Saɓani ya shiga tsakaninsu na ɗan lokaci. Aminullahi bai yarda ba, amma Yazid ya ce, "Malam yana da gaskiya. Ba na son zunubi a kaina." Ya mayar da kuɗinsa a aljihunsa. Ya ce, "Zan ware wannan kuɗin domin mahaifiyata." Bayan ɗan lokaci, Aminullahi ma ya ware nasa kuɗin. Saɓanin ya ƙare, suka sake yin dariya tare.

Malam Tanimu ya buɗe takardar tsiren, ya ce, "To, mu ci tsire tare. Hamayyar ƙwallo a filin wasa take ƙarewa, ba a cikin jirgi ba." Samarin suka yi dariya, suka ci tsiren tare da shi har jirgin ya isa Abuja.

Tambayoyi:
Me Malam Tanimu ya saya kafin ya hau jirgin?
Ya sayi tsire a bakin tashar.
Me ya sa akwai hamayya tsakanin samarin?
Saboda Aminullahi yana goyon bayan ƙungiyar Kano, Yazid kuma yana goyon bayan ƙungiyar Kaduna.
Me Malam Tanimu ya ce game da caca?
Ya ce caca haram ce, kuma zunubi ne a ci kuɗin wani ta hanyar caca.
Me ya sa Malam Tanimu ya ce ba shirme ba ne?
Saboda samarin suna cewa wasa ne, alhali kuwa kuɗinsu na gaske ne.
Me Yazid ya yi da kuɗinsa?
Ya ware kuɗin domin mahaifiyarsa.

lessons.title: Labarai a motar haya
lessons.summary: The Abuja taxi driver Malam Ɗanazumi and his passenger, the lecturer Rabi'atu, listen to the morning news: the transport minister has resigned, his successor promises millions for roads, jobs and loans for drivers, and the government plans a nuclear power station.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗanazumi direban motar haya ne a Abuja. Kowace safiya yakan kunna rediyo a cikin motarsa domin ya ji labarai. Wata safiya, wata malamar jami'a mai suna Malama Rabi'atu ta shiga motarsa, za ta je jami'a.

Da suka fara tafiya, labarai suka fara a rediyo. Mai karanta labarai ya ce, "Ministan sufuri ya yi murabus a jiya." Malam Ɗanazumi ya ce, "Kai! Ya yi murabus? Bai yi shekara ɗaya a ofis ba." Malama Rabi'atu ta ce, "Na ji an ce ya yi murabus ne saboda rashin lafiya."

Labarin ya ci gaba: "Shugaban ƙasa ya ayyana sabon ministan sufuri a yau. Sabon ministan kuma ya ayyana cewa gwamnati za ta kashe miliyoyin naira domin raya hanyoyi da layukan jirgin ƙasa. Ya ce aikin zai taimaka wa miliyoyin mutane da suke tafiya kowace rana."

Mai labaran ya ƙara da cewa, "Ministan ya ce aikin zai samarwa matasa dubu ɗari aikin yi. Kuma za a sake fasalin manyan tashoshin mota, domin mutane su sami sauƙi wajen hawa da sauka. Gwamnati za ta kuma ba direbobin motar haya bashi domin su sayi sababbin motoci. Bayarwa za ta fara a wata mai zuwa."

Malam Ɗanazumi ya yi dariya. Ya ce, "Idan bayarwar ta fara da gaske, ni ne na farko da zan nemi bashin. Motata ta tsufa sosai." Malama Rabi'atu ta ce, "Sake fasalin tashoshi ma abu ne mai kyau. Idan aka raya hanyoyi, za a fi samun kwanciyar hankali."

Sai labari na gaba ya zo: "Gwamnati tana shirin gina tashar wutar lantarki ta nukiliya." Malam Ɗanazumi ya tambayi Malama Rabi'atu, "Me ake nufi da nukiliya?" Ta ce, "Wani irin makamashi ne mai ƙarfi sosai. Tashar nukiliya tana iya ba da wutar lantarki ga miliyoyin gidaje, amma dole a kula da ita sosai."

Malam Ɗanazumi ya ce, "Wannan hangen nesa ne." Malama Rabi'atu ta ce, "Eh, hangen nesa yana da kyau. Amma mu talakawa muna so mu ga aikin, ba magana kawai ba."

Da suka isa jami'a, Malama Rabi'atu ta biya shi, ta ce, "Allah ya sa ka sami bashin." Ya ce, "Amin. Sai wata rana."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa ministan sufuri ya yi murabus?
An ce ya yi murabus ne saboda rashin lafiya.
Me sabon ministan ya ayyana?
Ya ayyana cewa gwamnati za ta kashe miliyoyin naira domin raya hanyoyi da layukan jirgin ƙasa.
Matasa nawa aikin zai samarwa aikin yi?
Aikin zai samarwa matasa dubu ɗari aikin yi.
Yaushe bayarwar bashin za ta fara?
Bayarwa za ta fara a wata mai zuwa.
Me Malama Rabi'atu ta ce game da tashar nukiliya?
Ta ce tana iya ba da wutar lantarki ga miliyoyin gidaje, amma dole a kula da ita sosai.

lessons.title: Keken Badariyya
lessons.summary: The widow Badariyya borrows a tricycle from her brother Gwadabe and starts carrying women around Kano after news of attacks on women at night; she works hard, a man who follows her and a student is arrested and jailed, and she buys the tricycle.
lessons.text:
Badariyya tana zaune a Kano tare da 'ya'yanta uku. Bayan mijinta ya rasu, matsin rayuwa ya yi mata yawa. Kuɗin makaranta, kuɗin abinci, kuɗin gida, duk suna kanta. Wannan matsi ne ya sa ta nemi sabuwar sana'a.

A wannan lokacin, ta ji labari a rediyo cewa an sami matsalolin fyaɗe a wasu wurare a cikin gari, a kan matan da suke dawowa daga kasuwa da dare. Wata ƙungiyar mata ta ce dole gwamnati ta yaƙi fyaɗe. Mata da yawa sun fara tsoron hawa keke mai ƙafa uku idan maza ne suke tuƙa shi da dare. Badariyya ta yi tunani: "Idan mace ce take tuƙa keken, mata za su fi samun kwanciyar hankali."

Ba ta da kuɗin sayen keke. Sai ta je wurin ɗan uwanta Gwadabe, wanda yake da kekuna masu ƙafa uku guda biyu. Ta ce ya ba ta ɗaya aro. Gwadabe ya ce, "Zan ba ki aron keken na wata shida. Idan kika sami kuɗi, sai ki saya daga gare ni."

Badariyya ta fara aiki tuƙuru. Tana tashi da wuri, tana ɗaukar mata zuwa kasuwa, asibiti da makaranta. Tana dawowa gida da dare. Mata suka fara kiran ta a waya: "Badariyya, ki zo ki ɗauke ni." Suna cewa da ita kawai suke yarda.

Wani dare, tana kai wata ɗaliba gida, sai ta ga wani mutum yana bin su a kan mota. Ya bi su daga titi ɗaya zuwa wani. Badariyya ba ta tsaya ba. Ta tuƙa keken kai tsaye zuwa ofishin 'yansanda, ta tsaya a ƙofar, ta yi ihu. 'Yansanda suka fito, suka kame mutumin.

Bayan an kame shi, aka gano cewa 'yansanda suna neman sa tun watanni saboda fashi a kan mata. Bayan wata biyu, kotu ta yanke masa hukuncin shekara bakwai a kurkuku. Badariyya ta ce wa ɗalibar, "Yanzu yana kurkuku, ba zai sake cutar da kowa ba."

Bayan wata shida na aiki tuƙuru, Badariyya ta tara kuɗin. Ta je wurin Gwadabe, ta biya shi kuɗin keken. Ta ce, "Na gode da aron da ka ba ni. Yanzu keken nawa ne." Bayan wata uku, ta sayi keke na biyu, ta ɗauki wata mace aiki.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Badariyya ta nemi sabuwar sana'a?
Saboda matsin rayuwa ya yi mata yawa bayan mijinta ya rasu.
Me ta ji a rediyo?
Ta ji cewa an sami matsalolin fyaɗe a kan matan da suke dawowa daga kasuwa da dare.
Ta yaya ta sami keke?
Ɗan uwanta Gwadabe ya ba ta aron kekensa na wata shida.
Me 'yansanda suka yi da mutumin da yake bin su?
Sun kame shi, kuma kotu ta yanke masa hukuncin shekara bakwai a kurkuku.
Yaya Badariyya ta yi aiki?
Ta yi aiki tuƙuru, tana tashi da wuri tana dawowa da dare.

lessons.title: Alade a hanyar gona
lessons.summary: Faisal drives mango seedlings from Jos to a village in the planting season; a pig runs out of the bush, his car hits it and he breaks a tooth, and the farmer Bulus, whose village it is, gives him honey and plants the seedlings with him.
lessons.text:
Faisal yana aiki a wata ƙungiya da ke taimaka wa manoma a Jihar Filato. Aikinsa shi ne ya kai wa manoma ƙananan bishiyoyi domin su dasa su a gonakinsu. Wata rana ya ɗora ƙananan bishiyoyin mangwaro ɗari biyu a kan wata mota, ya tashi daga Jos zuwa wani ƙauye.

Lokacin damina ne, kuma manoma suna shuka a gonakinsu. A gefen hanya, Faisal yana ganin maza da mata suna shuka masara da gyaɗa. Ganyen bishiyoyi kore ne ko'ina, kuma ciyawa ta yi tsayi.

Hanyar ƙauyen ba ta da kyau, saboda haka yana tafiya a hankali. Sai wani alade ya fito daga cikin daji a guje. Faisal ya tsayar da motar da sauri, amma motar ta buge aladen. Bakin Faisal ya bugi gaban motar, kuma wani haƙorinsa ya karye.

Faisal ya fito daga motar, jini yana fitowa daga bakinsa. Aladen yana kwance a ƙasa, amma bai mutu ba. Bayan ɗan lokaci ya tashi, ya koma cikin daji a guje. Wani manomi mai suna Bulus ya zo daga gonarsa. Ya ce, "Aladena ne! Ka buge shi?" Faisal ya ce, "Eh, ka yi haƙuri. Ya fito a gaban motar ba zato." Bulus ya ce, "Na gan shi, yana lafiya. Kai ne ka ji rauni. Haƙorinka ya karye!"

Bulus ya kai Faisal gidansa, ya ba shi ruwa ya wanke bakinsa. Matar Bulus ta kawo zuma a cikin ƙaramin kwano. Ta ce, "Zuma tana rage ciwo. Ka sa kaɗan a kan haƙorin." Faisal ya sa zumar a bakinsa, sai ciwon ya ragu kaɗan.

Faisal ya faɗa musu sunan ƙauyen da zai je. Bulus ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Wannan ƙauyenmu ne! Mu ne muke jiran bishiyoyin nan." Suka koma motar tare, suka kai bishiyoyin ƙauyen.

Da yamma, Faisal da Bulus suka dasa bishiyoyi goma a gonar Bulus. Sauran manoma suka dasa sauran. Bulus ya ce, "Duk lokacin da na ga ganyen waɗannan bishiyoyi, zan tuna da haƙorinka." Faisal ya yi dariya, ko da yake bakinsa yana ciwo. Washegari ya je wurin likitan haƙori a Jos.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Faisal ya je ƙauyen?
Ya je ya kai wa manoma ƙananan bishiyoyi domin su dasa su.
Me manoma suke yi a gefen hanya?
Suna shuka masara da gyaɗa a gonakinsu.
Me ya faru da Faisal lokacin da motar ta buge aladen?
Bakin Faisal ya bugi gaban motar, kuma wani haƙorinsa ya karye.
Me matar Bulus ta kawo?
Ta kawo zuma a cikin ƙaramin kwano.
Bishiyoyi nawa Faisal da Bulus suka dasa a gonar Bulus?
Sun dasa bishiyoyi goma.
